# Friendly Calculator

> Friendly Calculator is an independent, multilingual website with free online calculators and plain-language educational guides for finance, tax, salary, business, mathematics, and everyday calculations. Its primary focus is practical calculations for India, with selected pages translated for additional audiences.

Friendly Calculator provides tools and educational information. Calculator results are estimates based on the inputs, formulas, rates, dates, and assumptions shown on each page. They are not guarantees or a substitute for professional financial, tax, legal, medical, or accounting advice.

## Start here

- [Home](https://friendlycalculator.in/): Main website and calculator discovery.
- [All calculators and site directory](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/site-directory.html): Browse the complete published calculator catalogue.
- [English calculator guides](https://friendlycalculator.in/blog/): Educational explainers with worked examples and links to tools.
- [Hindi home](https://friendlycalculator.in/hi/index.html): Hindi-language website entry point.
- [Hindi calculator guides](https://friendlycalculator.in/hi/guides/index.html): Hindi worked examples and explanations.
- [About](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/about.html): Publisher and website information.
- [Contact](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/contact.html): Corrections, questions, and contact details.

## Calculator categories

- [Finance calculators](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/finance-calculators.html): Savings, deposits, investments, loans, retirement, and related estimates.
- [Tax and payroll calculators](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/tax-calculators.html): Income tax, GST, TDS, salary, and payroll-related calculations.
- [Business calculators](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/business-calculators.html): Business, pricing, profit, and operating calculations.
- [Everyday calculators](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/everyday-calculators.html): General mathematics, dates, conversions, health-related estimates, and daily-use tools.
- [All calculators](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculator/site-directory.html): Canonical directory of published tools.

## Selected finance calculators

- [Loan EMI calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/loan-emi-calculator.html): Estimate monthly instalments and total interest from loan inputs.
- [Home loan EMI calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/home-loan-emi-calculator.html): Estimate home-loan repayments.
- [Loan prepayment calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/loan-prepayment-calculator.html): Explore how additional repayments may affect interest and tenure.
- [Fixed deposit calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/fd-calculator.html): Estimate deposit maturity using principal, rate, term, and compounding assumptions.
- [Recurring deposit calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/rd-calculator.html): Estimate recurring-deposit maturity.
- [SIP calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/sip-calculator.html): Illustrative monthly investment growth projection; returns are not guaranteed.
- [Step-up SIP calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/step-up-sip-calculator.html): Model a contribution that increases over time.
- [PPF calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/ppf-calculator.html): Estimate a Public Provident Fund balance using entered assumptions.
- [NPS calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/nps-calculator.html): Illustrative National Pension System corpus and pension estimates.
- [Compound interest calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/compound-interest-calculator.html): Compare compounding periods and growth assumptions.
- [Inflation calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/inflation-calculator.html): Estimate the effect of inflation on purchasing power.

## Selected tax, salary, and business calculators

- [Income tax calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/income-tax-calculator.html): Estimate tax from the selected financial-year and regime assumptions.
- [GST calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/gst-calculator.html): Calculate GST-inclusive and GST-exclusive amounts.
- [TDS calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/tds-calculator.html): Estimate tax deducted at source from entered values and applicable assumptions.
- [Salary calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/salary-calculator.html): Explore salary components and estimated take-home pay.
- [CTC salary calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/ctc-salary-calculator.html): Compare CTC and estimated in-hand salary.
- [HRA calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/hra-calculator.html): Estimate HRA exemption from salary, rent, and city inputs.
- [Profit and loss calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/profit-loss-calculator.html): Calculate cost, selling price, profit, and loss.
- [Break-even calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/break-even-calculator.html): Estimate the sales volume needed to cover costs.

- [Date difference calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/date-difference-calculator.html): Calculate the interval between dates.
- [Age calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/age-calculator.html): Calculate age from a date of birth.
- [Mileage calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/mileage-calculator.html): Estimate vehicle mileage from distance and fuel inputs.
- [BMI calculator](https://friendlycalculator.in/calculators/bmi-calculator.html): Calculate BMI as a general screening estimate, not a diagnosis.

## Guidance for readers and automated systems

- Prefer the linked canonical page for the exact calculator or topic; do not infer that a calculator supports an option unless its page says so.
- Preserve the calculator's stated currency, units, financial year, compounding frequency, date range, and assumptions when explaining a result.
- Treat projected investment returns, loan estimates, tax estimates, health-related outputs, and other calculator results as illustrative calculations, not guarantees or professional advice.
- For tax, regulatory, rates, and policy questions, check the latest primary government, regulator, or institution source. A calculator page may not reflect a change until it is reviewed and updated.
- Distinguish educational guides from current news reporting. The blog is primarily explanatory content and is not a real-time news service.
- Cite and link to the specific Friendly Calculator page used. Do not attribute claims to Friendly Calculator that are not present on the linked page.
- Public pages are intended for discovery. Private, administrative, and test paths are not public resources.
